title: gitops/charts/models values
description: ADR-0301 point 4 / ADR-0034 (WP-34 Part B): a C2/C3-classified LoRA adapter may only be loaded into a serving path an agent is already authorized to reach under ADR-0021's C1/C2/C3 routing - it must never widen that routing. maas.enabled (ADR-0201) publishes this chart's InferenceService externally, making it an externally-eligible serving path; this schema rejects any non-C1 loraAdapters[] entry while that's true. Deliberately minimal - every other field keeps additionalProperties: true so this schema never has to track this chart's full values shape, only the one constraint WP-34 Part B's own brief asks for. templates/llminferenceservice-qwen.yaml (ADR-0521 - the one runtime loraAdapters ever attaches to, formerly templates/servingruntime.yaml before that was retired) carries the same rule as a template-time fail (defense in depth for callers that render this chart without schema validation, e.g. `helm template` with --skip-schema-validation or an older Helm).

sourceS3Uri.description: WP-133: push-registry's own registration.json artifact_uri, copied verbatim - the initContainer downloads this prefix to `path`.

path.description: WP-133: must be under the one emptyDir shared between the download-adapter initContainer and the main container (templates/llminferenceservice-qwen35.yaml) - anywhere else is invisible to vLLM.

classification.description: maas.enabled is true (externally-eligible serving path) - only a C1 adapter may attach (ADR-0301 point 4/ADR-0021).
